note: Triennial election of Antrim County Council; nominations received on 20 May 1952, withdrawals to 21 May, and polling, where necessary, on Thursday 5 June 1952 ('polling day will be Thursday, June 5', Belfast News-Letter, 21 May 1952, p. 10). There was no contest in any Antrim division, so no poll was held in the county. No party labels were printed. The returning officer's notice of result (Belfast Telegraph, 6 June 1952, p. 6) lists each division with its candidate, and the retiring members deemed re-elected where there was no nomination (Ballyclare and Glenarm). The 1952 notice's column of retiring members deemed re-elected is faintly printed at the page edge: the surname M'Connell and 'M'Cu...' of the forenames are legible, with his abode. The 1955 notice (Belfast Telegraph, 4 June 1955, p. 3) gives the member at that abode in full as John McCullough McConnell. Deemed re-elected (no nomination).
